identificationModule.officialTitle: Clinical Trial for the Safety and Efficacy of Induction Chemotherapy With Azacitidine+Venetoclax (VA) and Bridging CD19CD22 CAR-T Therapy in Adult Patients With Newly Diagnosed High-Risk and Ph-negative (Ph-) B-ALL

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: To evaluate the safety and efficacy of induction chemotherapy with VA regime and bridging CD19CD22 CAR-T therapy in Adult patients with newly diagnosed high-risk and Ph- B-ALL in this prospective, single arm study.

primaryOutcomes.description: MRD Negative Remission Rate after CD19CD22 cell therapy
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: The cycle of CD19CD22 cell therapy is day 2-4; Effect evaluation was day 21 after CD19CD22 cells infusion

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Complete Remission Rate of VA regime
secondaryOutcomes.description: Complete Remission Rate after VA regime
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: The cycle of VA regime is day 21; Effect evaluation was day 7 after VA regime

secondaryOutcomes.description: Complete Molecular Remission Rate after CD19CD22 CAR-T cell therapy
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: The cycle of CD19CD22 cell therapy is day 2-4; Effect evaluation was day 21 after CD19CD22 cells infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: From the first infusion of CD19CD22 cells to death or the last visit
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: The cycle of CD19CD22 cell therapy is day 2-4; Effect evaluation was 2 years after CD19CD22 CAR-T cells infusion
